name: AHMED AL-NAJJAR
intro: I create high-impact visual identities, event experiences, and realistic 3D concepts that connect creativity with real-world execution. With 8+ years of experience across branding, events, exhibitions, marketing, and visual communication, I transform ideas into clear, memorable, and production-ready experiences — from the first concept to final implementation.
contactText: Whether you’re planning an event, developing a brand experience, creating a campaign, or looking for realistic 3D visualization, I’d be happy to discuss how we can bring the idea to life.
about:
I’m Ahmed Al-Najjar, a multidisciplinary Senior Graphic Designer and 3D Event Experience Designer with more than 8 years of experience in visual communication, branding, events, exhibitions, marketing campaigns, and production design.

My approach goes beyond creating something that simply looks good. I focus on how a design works in the real world — how the brand interacts with the environment, how people experience the space, how materials behave, how elements are produced, and how every detail contributes to one consistent visual experience.

A major part of my work focuses on events and branded environments in Saudi Arabia, where I develop concepts for corporate events, activations, exhibitions, branded installations, stages, booths, signage, guest experiences, and event touchpoints.

I combine graphic design, spatial thinking, and realistic 3D visualization to bridge the gap between creative ideas and physical execution. From the initial brief to final production files, my goal is to create work that is visually strong, strategically clear, technically practical, and ready to become reality.

process.title: UNDERSTAND
process.description: Understanding the objective, audience, brand identity, physical environment, production requirements, and desired experience.

process.title: DEFINE THE DIRECTION
process.description: Translating the brief into a clear creative direction built around visual references, colors, materials, layout, storytelling, and spatial concepts.

process.title: DESIGN THE EXPERIENCE
process.description: Developing the concept across all relevant touchpoints — from graphics and branding to spaces, installations, signage, and environmental elements.

process.title: VISUALIZE
process.description: Creating realistic 3D scenes and mockups to communicate scale, materials, lighting, placement, proportions, and atmosphere.

process.title: REFINE
process.description: Reviewing every element for visual consistency, branding accuracy, production feasibility, proportions, materials, and implementation details.

process.title: PREPARE FOR PRODUCTION
process.description: Transforming final designs into clear, accurate, production-ready files that help execution teams reproduce the concept correctly.
